title: Degraded stock availability
description: Customers report items showing as unavailable and slow cart updates. inventory-service shows elevated latency and intermittent 5xx responses.
root_cause_detail: A dependency upgrade shipped in inventory-service v1.4.0 leaked buffers on every request.
expected_symptoms: inventory-service memory_usage climbs gradually from ~29% to ~99% over ~105+ minutes
increasing GC / heap pressure logs on inventory-service
inventory-service p95 latency rises from ~29ms to ~213ms as memory grows
inventory-service errors appear late, error rate up to ~20.6%
inventory-service db_connection_utilization stays within normal range
1 OOM kill / restart event(s) with memory drop and error spike
deployment of inventory-service v1.4.0 shortly before memory growth starts
resolution: Rolled back inventory-service to v1.3.3 and pinned the library version.
